title: Softmax Cross-Entropy Loss and Gradient
signature: def softmax_cross_entropy(logits: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> tuple
hints: Work with log-probabilities: log p = z - logsumexp(z). Never take the log of a softmax that may have underflowed to 0.
Shift each row by its max before exponentiating.
The gradient of the mean loss is (softmax(z) - onehot(y)) / N.
